description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, bringing improved performance, security patches, new language features, and long-term support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the project JDK/Java version to 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all compiler settings, toolchain configurations, and CI/CD pipeline references are updated to Java 25. Do not upgrade Spring Boot, Spring Framework, or Jakarta EE as part of this task.
tasks.summary: Upgraded project from Java 21 to Java 25. Updated pom.xml java.version property and Dockerfile base images (build: maven:3.9-eclipse-temurin-25, runtime: eclipse-temurin:25-jre-alpine). Build passes with JDK 25 and all unit tests pass.
